title: Settings
subtitle: Connections, paths, models, limits and access

status.title: Status
status.summary: Summary as the agent sees it

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.description: Checks connections, paths, hard links, permissions, space and indexers.

downloader.switchHelp: Another downloader is on and set up. Downloads already added stay with the one that added them.
downloader.switchBody: Downloads already added stay with the downloader that added them. Its folders may look different: check its path map after switching.
downloader.title: Downloader

mediaServer.switchHelp: Another media server is on and set up.
mediaServer.switchBody: Play links, watch history and suggestions will come from it. Its folders may look different: check its path map after switching.
mediaServer.title: Media server

services.title: Services
services.descriptionCards: Each service Reelix connects to: its state, what that means, and its settings and passwords together.
services.testAfterSetup: Fill in what is needed first, then test.

downloads.ok: Downloads start and finished ones are filed.
downloads.off: No downloads can start, and finished ones are not filed, until a downloader is set up.
downloads.broken: New downloads cannot start and finished ones wait to be filed. What is in the library is not affected.

mediaServer.ok: Play links, watch history and "For you" suggestions use it; the library is refreshed after filing.
mediaServer.off: Optional. Filing goes on; play links that need it, watch history, suggestions and the library refresh are off.
mediaServer.broken: Filing goes on; play links that need it, watch history, "For you" suggestions and the library refresh are off.

indexers.title: Indexers (Jackett)
indexers.what: Where releases are searched. Without it, nothing new can be found.
indexers.notEachTested: Connected. Its indexers are not tested one by one; ask the assistant to test them.

tmdb.title: Metadata (TMDB)
tmdb.what: Titles, posters, descriptions and episode lists come from TMDB.
tmdb.missing: Without a key, titles, posters and descriptions cannot be looked up.
tmdb.keyHelp: Free at themoviedb.org → Settings → API (the v3 key or the read access token). Sent only to TMDB.

subtitles.title: Subtitle sites
subtitles.what: Where subtitles come from. Sites without an account work as they are; an account adds more downloads a day.
subtitles.off: Subtitles are not searched until it is on.

site.assrt: Chinese subtitles; needs a free API token.
site.opensubtitles: Many languages; needs an API key. A username and password add more downloads a day.
site.subdl: Many languages; needs a free API key.
site.gestdown: English subtitles for shows; no account.
site.jimaku: Japanese subtitles for anime; needs a free API key.

telegram.what: Notices with buttons, and chat with the assistant. The Inbox in this app works without it.
telegram.unused: Optional. The Inbox in this app works without it.

magpie.title: magpie (model gateway)
magpie.unused: Optional. A gateway that routes model calls between providers and holds spending limits.
magpie.what: Address and key saved; test by refreshing this page.
magpie.urlHelp: Its address as Reelix reaches it, for example http://magpie:3425.
magpie.keyHelp: A magpie key with a spending limit set in magpie.
magpie.adminKeyHelp: Only to let Reelix manage magpie (routing groups and providers). It can change what every key may spend; leave it empty unless you want that.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: For services that are blocked or slow from home (TMDB, Telegram, subtitle sites).
proxy.useForHelpNamed: The services whose requests go through the proxy.

models.title: Models

roleHelp.background: Follows, the nightly summary, subtitle searches. Empty: same as Chat.
roleHelp.glossary: Reads a whole subtitle for names and tone; a large-context model suits it. Empty: same as Background jobs.
roleHelp.translate: The bulk of a subtitle translation; a cheap, fast model suits it. Empty: same as Background jobs.
roleHelp.review: Checks a translation. A different model from the translator catches more. Empty: same as Translation: lines.

models.resting: Skipped for now after an error: {{models}}.
models.magpieSpent: Reelix's key has spent its {{limit}} {{period}}; it renews {{reset}}.
models.magpieAdmin: Changes: ask in chat. Each one is planned, checked, and put back if it breaks a role.
models.magpieReadOnly: Read only. To let Reelix change routing groups and providers, add a second magpie key allowed to manage magpie as the secret magpie.admin_key.
models.translatorNotRunning: The translator "{{id}}" is not running; translations wait until it is. Switch its plugin on, or choose another.
models.descriptionShort: Which model does which work. Each list is tried in order: when one cannot answer, the next is used.
models.reasoningHelp: How long a reasoning model thinks before it answers. Higher is slower and costs more.
models.translatorHelpShort: Writes the lines of a subtitle translation. Searching and downloading subtitles work without it.
models.testRoleHelp: One short question through the chat role: the answer, the model that gave it, and how long it took.
models.providersHelp: Where the models come from. Sign in or enter a key here; signing out stops its models.

limits.title: Limits and schedule
limits.description: Background work stops starting new model runs at the cap; chat is not capped.
limits.pluginDailyUsdHelp: For each plugin that uses your models, unless you set its own on its page. Resets at midnight.
limits.dailyHelp: Background jobs pause when it is reached and go on the next day. Chat is not limited.
limits.suggestionsHelp: For the "For you" suggestions, inside the background limit.
limits.stalledHelp: A download with no progress for this long is reported as stalled.
limits.trashHelp: Removed files wait this long in the trash before they are deleted.
limits.nightlyHelp: When the nightly tidy-up and summary run.

agent.editPrefsPrompt: Show me my preferences note, then let's change it:

learned.description: Skills the agent wrote for itself.
learned.empty: Nothing yet. When the agent works something out about your setup (a site's quirks, a naming habit), it writes it down as a skill and it shows up here.
learned.changePrompt: About the skill "{{name}}" you wrote: change this:
learned.deleteDescription: The agent forgets what this skill told it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: This device's own notifications when Reelix needs you. Tapping one opens the item in the Inbox.
notifications.sent: Sent. It should arrive in a moment.
notifications.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, first add Reelix to the Home Screen: Share → Add to Home Screen. Open it from there, sign in, and come back here.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications from web apps.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for Reelix. Allow them in the system or browser settings, then come back.
notifications.pluginOff: The notifications plugin is switched off. Switch it on under Plugins.
notifications.needsHttpsInbox: Browser notifications need HTTPS (see docs/deployment.md, "HTTPS"). The Inbox works without them.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: What is added to Reelix. Switching one on or off takes effect at once.
plugins.confirmTitle: Switch off {{id}} and what depends on it?
plugins.trialHelp: Its hooks run and Reelix records what they would change; nothing is applied. Its code still runs, with its network calls.
plugins.trialNone: No decisions yet in this trial.
plugins.trialFirst_one: would have changed the first candidate {{count}} time
plugins.trialFirst_other: would have changed the first candidate {{count}} times
plugins.toolsHelp: {{tools}}. Off: the assistant reaches its operations through the reelix tool only. Applies from the next conversation.
plugins.hookOrderHelp: In these steps each plugin changes what the one before it produced, so the order matters. The first runs first.
plugins.restartNeededManual: Restart Reelix to load: {{ids}}. Run `docker compose restart reelix`, or stop `reelix serve` and start it again.
plugins.installTitle: Install a plugin or skill pack
plugins.installHelp: A git URL pinned to a full commit id (…/repo.git#<commit>), npm:<name>@<exact version>, or a folder's full path.
plugins.installing: Fetching it and its dependencies; install scripts are never run. This can take a minute.
plugins.reviewWarning: This is what the plugin says about itself; its code has not run. Once approved, its code runs inside Reelix and can do anything Reelix can.
plugins.reviewSkills: A skill pack: instructions for the assistant, and scripts it may run. It has no code that runs inside Reelix.
plugins.scriptsWarning: Contains scripts the assistant may run

flag.unmetered: Asks to run without a daily budget

plugins.nativeHelp: It has compiled dependencies. Reelix installs them only when ready-made binaries exist for this machine; nothing is compiled here.
plugins.diffTitle: What changed in what it declares
plugins.uninstallHelp: Its code is removed. Its settings, secrets and stored data are kept, so installing it again brings them back, unless you tick below.
plugins.deleteData: Also delete its settings, secrets and stored data
plugins.jobPromptHelp: What it adds to the assistant's instructions also reaches background jobs, where nobody is watching. Off unless you allow it.
plugins.setupMessage: I switched on the plugin {{id}}. Walk me through setting it up (the {{skill}} skill).
plugins.setupOffer: The assistant can walk you through setting up {{id}}.
plugins.setupStart: Set it up with the assistant

model.title: Your models
model.spent: Today: ${{usd}} of ${{budget}} ({{tokens}} tokens). Resets at midnight.
model.reached: The budget is used up: its model calls wait until midnight.

plugins.waitsForMissing: Waiting for the plugin {{id}} {{range}}: it is not installed
plugins.waitsForPlugin: Waiting for the plugin {{id}} {{range}}: there is {{version}}, {{state}}
plugins.proposalFailed: The proposal could not be handled
plugins.proposalHelp: Written by the agent. Nothing of it runs until you approve it; approving installs it as a folder, and it starts after a restart.
plugins.reviewWarningProcess: This is what the plugin says about itself; its code has not run. Once approved, its code runs in a process of its own with only its context. Node keeps it from Reelix's files and secrets, from starting programs and from compiled addons; Reelix's code in that process keeps it off the network except through Reelix. That holds a careless plugin, not yet a hostile one: install only code you trust.
plugins.runtimeProcess: in a process of its own
plugins.runtimeNoProcess: inside Reelix only (a raw pi extension or compiled code)
plugins.runtime: Run in a process of its own
plugins.runtimeHelp: Its code gets only its context. Node keeps it from Reelix's files, secrets and database and from starting programs; Reelix's code in that process keeps its network to Reelix's fetch, to the hosts it declares. That holds a careless plugin, not yet a hostile one. Off: it runs inside Reelix, where it can do anything Reelix can. Its author's default: {{default}}.
plugins.runtimeNotPossible: It cannot run in a process of its own: it has a raw pi extension or compiled dependencies.
plugins.installIntro: Nothing runs until you approve what it declares.

channels.title: Chat channels
channels.empty: No chat channel is set up. A chat app is set up on its plugin's page under Plugins (for Telegram: telegram).
channels.mayApproveHelp: When on, your answers in this chat count as your approval, for example of a change to magpie. When off, such approvals are given in the web app.
channels.unlinkBody: The bot stops answering you until you link it again with a new code.
channels.sendFailed: The last message could not be sent ({{ago}}): {{error}}
channels.setUpHere: Chat apps are set up under Services (Telegram).

folderPicker.title: Choose a folder
folderPicker.description: Folders inside the media folder ({{root}}), as Reelix sees them. Open a folder, then choose it.
folderPicker.truncated: Only the first 1000 folders are shown.

level.downloads: Choose the folder your downloader saves into. It must be on the same disk and shared folder as the library, so files can be hard-linked.
level.library: Choose the folder Jellyfin scans as this library: the one that holds a folder per title, not a title's own folder. For now each media type has one library folder.

folderPicker.tooDeep: This is a single title's folder (or one of its season folders). Go up to the folder that holds all the titles.

libraryFolders.animeUsesShows: No folder of its own: anime goes to the shows' folders.
libraryFolders.remove: Remove the folder from the list (nothing on disk changes)
libraryFolders.name: Name
libraryFolders.help: Rules are checked from the top. A title matches a rule when it has one of the values listed for each field you fill in. A title no rule decides goes to the default folder; with none, the assistant chooses by what each folder already holds and asks you if it is not sure. A title already in the library stays where it is.
libraryFolders.learn: Ask the assistant to learn the rules
libraryFolders.learnPrompt: Look at what each of my library folders for {{type}} already holds and propose rules for which titles go where (skill library-folders).

search.label: Search settings
search.nothing: No setting matches. Try another word, or turn off "Needs attention".

form.optionsWhenOn: The choices appear when the plugin is on
form.managedSet: Made by Reelix; nothing to enter here.
form.managedNotYet: Reelix makes it when it is first needed; nothing to enter here.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.configEffect: Reelix keeps the settings it had before; the change in config.yaml is not used.
attention.noModelEffect: Chat, background jobs, subtitle translation and image reading are off. Downloads already planned and filing go on.
attention.noTmdbEffect: Titles, posters and descriptions cannot be looked up, so new titles cannot be found.
attention.waiting: {{name}} is waiting for something it needs
attention.capReached: Today's background budget is used up
attention.capReachedEffect: Background jobs wait until tomorrow; chat goes on.

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Where downloads and the library are, as Reelix sees them (inside its container). Both must be in one folder for hard links.
folders.mediaRootHelp: The one folder that holds downloads and library, as Reelix sees it. The folder pickers below browse inside it.
folders.downloadsHelp: Where your downloader saves. Files stay here and keep seeding.
folders.libraryIntro: Library folders (hard-link destinations): the folders Jellyfin scans. Reelix puts hard links here.

pathMap.title: How it names the folders
pathMap.help: {{service}} may run in another container and see the same folders under other paths. One row per folder that differs.
pathMap.none: No rows: {{service}} sees folders where Reelix does. If not, add one, for example {{theirs}} → {{ours}}.

check.missing: This folder does not exist for Reelix.
check.case: Not found; did you mean {{path}}? Letter case matters.
check.outside: This is not inside the media folder.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.description: Which sites to ask, in order, and which languages you want.
subtitles.sourcesHelp: The first site that has a good subtitle wins. Each site is only asked for the languages and kinds of title it covers.
subtitles.sitesOff: The subtitle sites plugin is off (Plugins).
subtitles.languagesHelp: None chosen: follow the language of Reelix (French and Russian also accept English).

playback.title: Playback
playback.description: The apps offered to play a title, in order.
playback.playersHelp: Players not ticked come after these.
playback.needsServerMissing: needs the media server, which is not connected

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: What the assistant knows about you, and what it has written for itself.
assistant.preferencesHelp: The note the assistant reads in every conversation: qualities, subtitles, what to avoid.
assistant.preferencesEmpty: For example: Films in 1080p; 4K only if I ask. Subtitles: Chinese and English.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Rarely needed: time limits of commands, proxies per service, the order of plugin steps.
advanced.shellHelp: How long a command the assistant runs may take by default.
advanced.perServiceHelp: A different proxy, or none, for one service.
